definitions.explanation: The vacation period during winter, typically from late December to early January for schools, and around the New Year period for workplaces.

examples.japanese: {冬休|ふゆやす}みが{始|はじ}まった。
{冬休|ふゆやす}みに{家族|かぞく}で{旅行|りょこう}する{予定|よてい}です。
examples.english: I plan to travel with my family during winter break.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもたちは{冬休|ふゆやす}みの{宿題|しゅくだい}をまだ{終|お}わらせていない。
examples.english: The children still haven't finished their winter break homework.

notes:
The vacation period during winter, typically from late December to early January.

FORMS:
{冬|ふゆ} (winter) + {休|やす}み (break/holiday)

CULTURAL NOTE:
School {冬休|ふゆやす}み typically runs about two weeks (late December to early January), much shorter than {夏休|なつやす}み. It overlaps with {年末年始|ねんまつねんし} (year-end and New Year period), the most important holiday season in Japan.

SEASONAL BREAK SET:
- {春休|はるやす}み: spring break (late March to early April)
- {夏休|なつやす}み: summer vacation (late July to late August, longest)
- {冬休|ふゆやす}み: winter break (late December to early January)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {冬休|ふゆやす}みの{宿題|しゅくだい}: winter break homework
- {冬休|ふゆやす}みに{入|はい}る: to enter winter break
